source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi, oops—I thought I had already replied!

We’d like to proceed with the agreed final version shown above, rev4-02. Thank you!

Am I correct in assuming that the logo will be supplied both with and without the black box, since a black box will not be suitable for every use?

Will we also receive every colour variant you’ve presented?

That said, I believe the primary logo should be the version in the top row of the final design: graduated orange ‘global’, black ‘dough’, and the strapline in graduated orange.

What we now need is the logo guidelines and every file type required for use online, on social media, on the truck itself, and across other hard copy materials, eg pull up banners, printed menus, uniform, etc.

Given that the files will have large file sizes, how will you share them? Wetransfer?

Thank you, [CLIENT_NAME_001]

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Hi, [FREELANCER_NAME_001] only now found the time to sit down and open the files on my laptop. Unfortunately, the colour codes doc will not open because it displays an error. The jpgs and pdfs open without any problems, but I’m unable to open the AI, EPS, or PSD files. For the png files, only logo 4 opens correctly; none of the others open properly. Also, when we create the website and other materials, which font should we use? Did you use an existing font, or did you create it? If you created it, which font would complement the logo or potentially match it for uses such as some headers? Thanks, [CLIENT_NAME_001]

execution.observed_behavior: The client reports that only logo 4 opens correctly as a PNG and that the other supplied PNG logo files do not open properly; the JPG files open without problems.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
[FREELANCER_NAME_001] checked the PNG files, and the logos are opening properly. What’s happening is that the background color blends into sections of the logo, which makes it look like the logo isn’t displaying correctly.

Zooming in will allow you to see the text and logo clearly. A simple way to verify this is by dragging and dropping the PNG file into any web browser or paint app. It should display correctly there, allowing you to view it without any issues.

Please let me know after you’ve checked.

execution.observed_behavior: The freelancer reports checking the PNG files and observing that they open properly; the apparent display problem is caused by the background color blending with parts of the logo, which remain visible when zoomed or viewed in a browser or paint application.

routing_warnings.description: The client's inability to open the AI, EPS, and PSD files concerns editable vector and source files rather than raster logo files.
The colour-codes document error concerns the brand color specification.
The client's questions about the logo lettering and complementary fonts concern brand typography guidance.
